source: Pulford et al. 2022, J Epidemiol Community Health 76:909-917, online supplemental additional file 1 (jech-2022-219292supp001.pdf), Figure S2.1 Scopus search strategy, pages 1-2 only
methods_text: MEDLINE, Embase, ASSIA, Scopus, IBSS, PsycINFO, EconLit, SocINDEX and Sociological Abstracts, up to March 2019. Search strategy developed with an information scientist, including terms related to precarious employment and additional health-related terms that were included in searches of non-health databases. Relevant grey literature identified as part of a wider scoping review was also considered.
